id: \rI have a sneaky move for you.
en: \rI have a sneaky move for you.

id: \bThat's as far as I can take you I'm afraid. Try going to the other side of the island. They have a ferry that can take you.
en: \bThat's as far as I can take you I'm afraid. Try going to the other side of the island. They have a ferry that can take you.
it: \bTemo di non poterti portare più in là. Prova ad andare dall'altra parte dell'isola. Lì c'è un traghetto che può portarti.

id: \bI can take you to Mossdeep City.
en: \bI can take you to Mossdeep City.

id: \rI want to enter the contest here, but it is just too far away.
en: \rI want to enter the contest here, but it is just too far away.
it: \rVorrei partecipare alla gara qui, ma è davvero troppo lontano.

id: \bThis place is the best to fish. All the noise lures em right in.
en: \bThis place is the best to fish. All the noise lures em right in.
it: \bQuesto è il posto migliore per pescare. Tutto il rumore li attira dritti qui.

id: \bThe ferry really brings this place to life.
en: \bThe ferry really brings this place to life.
it: \bIl traghetto dà davvero vita a questo posto.

id: \bDid you come here to compete in the contest?
en: \bDid you come here to compete in the contest?
it: \bSei venuto qui per partecipare alla gara?

id: \bI'm so glad a forest is here! I get to spend all day exploring.
en: \bI'm so glad a forest is here! I get to spend all day exploring.
it: \bChe bello che qui ci sia una foresta! Posso passare tutto il giorno a esplorare.

id: \bBe warned. This island holds all kinds of elements. Get prepared before you explore.
en: \bBe warned. This island holds all kinds of elements.  Get prepared before you explore.
it: \bTi avverto. Quest'isola racchiude ogni sorta di elemento.  Preparati bene prima di esplorarla.

id: \bThis is the best area to fish. Not too busy or hot.
en: \bThis is the best area to fish. Not too busy or hot.
it: \bQuesta è la zona migliore per pescare. Non troppo affollata né troppo calda.

id: \bThe desert is so hot. I wish it would wash away.
en: \bThe desert is so hot. I wish it would wash away.
it: \bIl deserto è caldissimo. Vorrei che sparisse sotto la pioggia.

id: \bI came here to explore. I just need a quick break.
en: \bI came here to explore. I just need a quick break.
it: \bSono venuto qui a esplorare. Mi serve solo una breve pausa.

id: \bDrake: Perhaps you are a strong Trainer? Oh, seven badges from Hoenn. You might even be a challenge.
en: \bDrake: Perhaps you are a strong Trainer? Oh, seven badges from Hoenn. You might even be a challenge.
it: \bDrake: Forse sei un Allenatore forte? Oh, sette medaglie di Hoenn. Potresti persino rappresentare una sfida.

id: \bDrake: You seem like you're becoming a strong Trainer. Don't become too cocky from all the power though. Farewell.
en: \bDrake: You seem like you're becoming a strong Trainer. Don't become too cocky from all the power though. Farewell.
it: \bDrake: Sembra che tu stia diventando un Allenatore forte. Però non montarti la testa per tutto questo potere. Addio.
